changelog: v1.1.3 - Attendance notification is now one silent, live-ticking notification instead of a new alert every minute
features: Attendance notification now posts once at punch-in and ticks live on its own (Android's chronometer) - no more repeat alerts every minute, and it's silent
Notification fix: push notifications now reach your phone for leave approvals, holidays, payslips, document status, and broadcasts - not just the in-app notifications list
Attendance fix: punch-in/out time and "hours worked today" now show correctly
In-app update: download with a progress bar and install without leaving the app
